title: Bump crate-jmap past v0.5.0; consider jmap-server's i18n in place of mimid's own language handling
description: mimid pins crate-jmap at v0.5.0 (0972e7a4). Unreleased crate-jmap main (per its CHANGELOG [Unreleased], reported by the crate-jmap session 2026-11-15) adds, all additively: i18n (locale/localizations on Mailbox, AddressBook, Principal; JmapObject::LOCALIZABLE; language argument and i18n gating on /get, /query, /queryChanges in jmap-server), RFC 9457 ClientError::Problem in jmap-base-client, and problem details from the testjig. jmap-chat-mimi-types is unchanged. When the next crate-jmap release is out: move the pin, and see whether jmap-server's language/localizations handling can replace mimid's own (src/jmap/language.rs, Chat only), keeping mimid's Chat name/description mapping from RoomMetaData.
